done_when: forge.toml sets the review model to gpt-6-sol and no gpt-6-astra remains

findings.body: The branch changes the review model but adds no test that invokes Forge’s own command and verifies reviews use `gpt-6-sol`. Add a repository-suite test that fails if the review command selects the old model.
findings.title: Not done: an end-to-end test verifies the review model

why: Reviews should use the same Codex model as every other role
